name: Shawl
description: A worn cloth shawl pulled over the head. Offers little protection but keeps out the chill.

name: Leather Cap
description: A simple cap of boiled leather. Better than nothing.

name: Iron Helm
description: A sturdy iron helmet that covers the skull and cheeks.

name: Ogre Helm
description: A massive, terrifying helmet forged from dark iron and reinforced with ogre tusks. It exudes a primal aura of strength.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Helm
description: A lightweight elven helm forged from shimmering silver and inlaid with glowing amethyst. It enhances the wearer's agility and focus.
